from rdkit import Chem

se = [a for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Se'][0]

def set_E_stereo(mol):
    for cb in [n for n in se.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C']:
        db=None; ca=None
        for b in cb.GetBonds():
            if b.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE:

        s_ca=None

            if any(bb.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE and bb.GetOtherAtom(n).GetSymbol()=='O' for bb in n.GetBonds()):
                s_ca=n.GetIdx()
        db.SetStereoAtoms(s_ca, se.GetIdx())
        db.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE)

set_E_stereo(m)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)

params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()

    c1=None; c3=None
    for n in ca.GetNeighbors():
        if n.GetIdx()==cb.GetIdx(): continue
        if any(bb.GetBondType()==Chem.BondType.DOUBLE and bb.GetOtherAtom(n).GetSymbol()=='O' for bb in n.GetBonds()):

import numpy as np, math
lines=[l.split() for l in open('answer.xyz').read().strip().split('\n')[2:]]
el=[l[0] for l in lines]
xyz=np.array([[float(v) for v in l[1:4]] for l in lines])

def dih(a,b,c,d):
    p0,p1,p2,p3=xyz[a],xyz[b],xyz[c],xyz[d]
    b0=-(p1-p0); b1=p2-p1; b2=p3-p2
    b1/=np.linalg.norm(b1)
    v=b0-np.dot(b0,b1)*b1; w=b2-np.dot(b2,b1)*b1
    x=np.dot(v,w); y=np.dot(np.cross(b1,v),w)
    return math.degrees(math.atan2(y,x))
